drivers: one small team (the user), one release cadence
strong consistency between expenses, budget membership and budget totals
low volume: household-sized budgets, no independent scaling need
permission checks must be identical on every read (shared budgets)

alternatives.reason: Network calls and distributed data for a few small modules, with no team or scaling reason to split them
No existing system that must stay separate; the OCR provider is reached through an adapter, not a service of ours
OCR and invitation email are naturally asynchronous, but volume is low and a synchronous call with a timeout and manual fallback is enough
A monolith plus a background job for OCR would fit if scans prove slow; revisit then (decision D04)

style.reason: Simplest design that meets every driver; module boundaries keep the expense, budget and receipt rules separate without a second deployable

stack.frontend: Server-rendered, mobile-first web pages (Django templates) with a small amount of plain JavaScript; camera capture through the browser file input
stack.storage: S3-compatible private object storage for receipt images
stack.email: Transactional email provider through Django's email backend (console backend in development)
stack.ocr: Receipt OCR provider behind a ReceiptReader adapter, chosen by the user before slice V3; a deterministic fake reader for development and tests
stack.hosting: A managed platform with managed PostgreSQL, chosen by the user at deployment (not part of this plan)

reasons.backend: D01: Spendly (the user's own code, reuse allowed) is Python, so its category rule is adapted directly; Django gives accounts, password hashing, sessions, CSRF, migrations and email without extra packages
reasons.database: D02: relational data with foreign keys, constraints and per-month sums; boring and managed everywhere
reasons.frontend: D03: the user uses Tallyho on a phone; a mobile-first web app can use the camera through the file input without app-store builds; one codebase
reasons.storage: D13: receipt photos are personal data and must not be public or in the database
reasons.ocr: D07: Tallyho's engine is closed and unknown; the provider needs the user's own account and keys, so it is an adapter with a fake for tests
reasons.email: D08: invitations need outbound email; adapter so development and tests send nothing

modules.name: accounts
modules.responsibility: Sign-up, sign-in, sign-out, email verification, sessions; the User record (platform piece, no source feature)

modules.name: mailer
modules.responsibility: Send transactional email through the configured backend (platform piece)

modules.name: categories
modules.responsibility: The four fixed categories and their validation, adapted from Spendly

modules.name: budgets
modules.responsibility: Create and edit budgets, membership records, and the one permission function used by every module ('may this user do this to this budget or expense')

modules.name: members
modules.responsibility: Email invitations (owner-only, single-use, 7-day expiry) and owner removal of members

modules.name: expenses
modules.responsibility: Create, list, edit and delete expenses (personal or in a budget), with amount, currency, date, merchant, category and note validation

modules.name: budget-period
modules.responsibility: Spent-of-limit for a budget for a calendar month in the budget's time zone; the budget overview

modules.name: receipts
modules.responsibility: Receipt upload and private storage, OCR through the ReceiptReader adapter, the review draft with date checks, and confirming a draft into an expense

entities.name: User
entities.notes: Tallyho's account model is undocumented; Spendly has no users. Email is unique (case-insensitive) and must be verified before accepting invitations.

entities.name: Budget
entities.notes: One owner (owner_id, also a Membership with role owner). limit_minor > 0. currency is ISO 4217. time_zone is an IANA name used for the monthly period.

entities.name: Membership
entities.notes: Unique (budget_id, user_id). removed_at set when the owner removes a member: the row stays so their expenses can be shown as from a former member; access requires removed_at is null.

entities.name: Invitation
entities.notes: Tallyho's invitation record is not documented; this one is new. Token stored only as a hash; single use; expires_at = created + 7 days.

entities.name: Expense
entities.notes: amount_minor > 0 (Spendly's integer cents; Tallyho's undocumented amount). category in (food, travel, home, other). budget_id null means personal. When budget_id is set, currency must equal the budget's currency (checked in the expenses module).

entities.name: Receipt
entities.notes: Tallyho exposes no receipt record; this one holds the private image key and the OCR draft. status in (uploaded, read, failed, confirmed).

auth.method: Email and password (Django auth, PBKDF2 or Argon2 hashing), with email verification
auth.session: Server-side session in an http-only, secure, SameSite=Lax cookie; CSRF token on every state-changing request

permissions.budget: current members: view budget, members and all expenses; owner: edit budget, invite, remove members
permissions.budget expense: current members: view, add; author (while a current member): edit, delete; owner: delete any
permissions.former member: no access to the budget or any of its expenses, including their own
permissions.receipt: uploader; once confirmed, same access as its expense

navigation.screen: Budget overview (spent of limit this month, expenses)

api.auth: session (uploader, or access to its expense)

components: budget progress bar (under, near, over limit)
design_system.note: The user's own palette and name; nothing visual, textual or iconic taken from Tallyho

configuration.EMAIL_BACKEND_URL: email provider connection (secret); console in development
configuration.OCR_PROVIDER: which ReceiptReader adapter (fake in development and tests)
configuration.OCR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: default 20; on timeout the review screen opens empty for manual entry
configuration.note: Read in one settings module; .env.example lists names only; secrets never in code or logs

slices.name: Core loop: sign in, add an expense with a Spendly category, see it listed
Shared budgets: create, invite by email, join, see this month's spent of limit
Receipt scanning: photo, OCR draft, check date, pick category, save into a budget
Owner removes a member; expenses stay, marked former member; access revoked

decisions.reason: Spendly is Python (adapt its category rule); batteries for auth, sessions, CSRF, migrations, email
Relational data, constraints, monthly sums; managed everywhere

decisions.decision: Frontend: server-rendered mobile-first web pages with camera capture via file input; JSON API at /api/v1 for the scan flow and tests
decisions.reason: User scans on a phone; one codebase, no app-store builds

decisions.decision: Style: modular monolith; OCR called synchronously with a timeout and manual fallback
decisions.reason: One team, strong consistency, low volume; revisit (hybrid with a job) only if scans prove slow

decisions.decision: Money: bigint minor units + ISO 4217 currency; budget expenses must match the budget currency; conversion deferred (M02)
Removed member: membership soft-removed (removed_at); expenses stay, shown as former member; no access afterwards
OCR behind a ReceiptReader adapter; provider chosen by the user before V3 (their account and keys); fake reader for development and tests
decisions.reason: Tallyho's engine is closed and unknown; real OCR cannot be exercised without the user's keys and network

decisions.decision: Email behind Django's email backend; console backend in development, locmem in tests
decisions.reason: Invitations need email; tests must send nothing

decisions.decision: Categories: Spendly's four values as one constant plus a database check constraint; category required everywhere, no default on scans
decisions.reason: User asked for Spendly's categories; compatibility decision category-on-scanned-expenses

decisions.decision: Defer foreign-currency conversion (M02) and the public token API (M11); drop Tallyho's category field (M10)
decisions.reason: Auto-pick: could features adding risk deferred; user chose Spendly's categories

decisions.decision: uuid primary keys generated by the app
decisions.reason: Neither source has a known key type; no data to re-key

decisions.decision: Scanned date must be confirmed; missing, future or older-than-90-days dates become today and are flagged
decisions.reason: User's notes: the scanned date is often wrong

decisions.decision: Receipt images in private S3-compatible storage, served only through the permission check, deleted with the expense or after 24 hours if never confirmed
Invitations: owner-only, single-use hashed token, 7-day expiry, accepted only by a verified account with the invited email
Monthly period: calendar month in the budget's time zone, computed at read time, no rollover, nothing deleted

API: REST JSON under /api/v1; error shape {"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}; cursor pagination (?cursor=, limit default 50, max 200); session auth for every endpoint except sign-up, sign-in and verification; non-members get 404 for budget resources
decisions.reason: One style, one error shape, one auth scheme; 404 avoids revealing that a budget exists
